standard_prerequisites.name: Completeness theorem, first version
standard_prerequisites.use: Contraposed: not satisfiable implies inconsistent; applied to Gamma union {not A}.

standard_prerequisites.name: Entailment to unsatisfiability
standard_prerequisites.use: Gamma entails A makes Gamma union {not A} unsatisfiable.

standard_prerequisites.name: Inconsistency explodes derivability
standard_prerequisites.statement: If Gamma union {not A} is inconsistent then Gamma proves A (the per-proof-system prov-inconsistency fact, cited through the tagrefs block).
standard_prerequisites.use: Final step: converts the inconsistency of Gamma union {not A} into the derivation Gamma proves A.

core_obligations: Statement (lines 1034-1038): if Gamma entails A then Gamma proves A.

Proof (lines 1040-1064): restate the first version with a fresh variable Delta to keep the universally quantified Gamma's apart; contrapose to 'not satisfiable implies inconsistent'; Gamma entails A makes Gamma union {not A} unsatisfiable (prop:entails-unsat); the contraposed completeness makes it inconsistent; the prov-inconsistency fact yields Gamma proves A.
proof_roadmap: Contrapose the first version of the theorem.
Derive unsatisfiability of Gamma union {not A} from the entailment.
Convert inconsistency into the desired derivation.
difficulty_reason: Deductive completeness corollary (statement 1034-1038, proof 1040-1064): complete contraposition chain with each step's citation named; the restatement under a fresh variable is the author's own. H2.
